Name: Cookout Kit Rebalance
Author: shrikeexitium
Description:
[color=#c389d9][b][size=4]Introduction[/size][/b][/color]

Wondering why you can make torches at any time, but need Foraging Level 3 to make food hot? Confused why a simple cooking kit needs more coal than smelting iridium? Tired of having your basic survival skills showed up by that smug berry-eating mountain man? Look no further!
[b]

[color=#c389d9][size=4]What This Mod Does[/size][/color][/b]

Rebalances the Cookout Kit to be:
[list]
[*]Available at Foraging 1
[*]Require 5 Sap instead of 3 Coal
[*]Sell for 20g to account for cheaper ingredients
[/list]
(There is a GMCM compatible version available in the downloads that allows you dynamically adjust both the recipe and the foraging level if you want tailor the Cooking Kit to your personal preference.)

[color=#c389d9][b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b][/color][b]
[/b]
Should be compatible with most mods. Will conflict with mods that edit the Cookout Kit.


[color=#c389d9][size=4][b]Recommended Mods to Use With[/b][/size][/color]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12179]Survivalistic[/url]﻿ - Adds nutrition and hydration needs. Gives the Cookout Kit a genuine purpose!
